content: Minimum viable Python subprocess safety net for untrusted code: use preexec_fn/resource.setrlimit (RLIMIT_CPU, RLIMIT_AS, RLIMIT_NOFILE, RLIMIT_NPROC=0 to block fork) applied in the child before exec; run python3 -I (isolated mode); spawn with start_new_session=True/os.setsid so os.killpg can kill the whole process group, not just the parent; keep a wallclock subprocess.run(timeout=) as backstop even with in-process alarms; use tempfile.mkdtemp per submission and delete after; never run as root (root can escape chroot); avoid RLIMIT_FSIZE=0 since it SIGKILLs on any write including stderr.
